rules.sentence: PAH has a prevalence of 7% to 19% in patients with SSc and accounts for about 30% of the mortality in SSc.
However, owing to nonspecific manifestations (dyspnea, exercise intolerance, and fatigue), patients are typically diagnosed at advanced stages with poorer outcomes.
Early screening and diagnosis of PAH followed by prompt initiation of risk-based treatment have been shown to improve outcomes and delay the progression of PAH.
